market_summary: London session displays clear risk-off/crypto and metals liquidation while major FX pairs compress tightly inside session value areas. Gold (XAUUSD), US100, and Bitcoin (BTCUSD) are all executing high-conviction bearish continuations below declining VWAPs, beneath their Value Area Lows/POCs, backed by negative Cumulative Delta. Meanwhile, EURUSD and GBPUSD remain trapped in mid-channel chop directly around VWAP/POC, dictating patience on currencies while riding momentum breakdowns on risk assets.

signals.rationale: Evaluating the 7 confluences: 1) Profile: price_vs_value_area is below_val (VAL 3962.32) and close_vs_poc is below (POC 3978.28), confirming strong session value migration down. 2) CVD is BEARISH (-3.83, slope -0.84), fully agreeing with downside pressure. 3) Session: LONDON_SESSION, active volume window. 4) Trend: price cleanly below VWAP (3970.06) and EMA50 (3964.99). 5) ATR: consolidating under EMA20 inside lower half of ATR band (lower band 3936.36). 6) RVOL is 0.744 without spike, marking an orderly continuation stall rather than exhaustion. 7) Levels: formed rejection near EMA20/mid-channel, heading toward Session Low 3924.30. GEX is null. Clear short-trend continuation setup.

lucid_plan.sizing: fixed target 1.3 reaches $502 net with 4 GC (risk $1280)
